summary: Scope finite-work memory pressure to its lanes and protect host free memory

schema.detail: No client schema, generated code or API shape changes.

rules.detail: Linux finite-work admission combines aggregate lane memory PSI, root memory full PSI qualified by a positive delta in the sum of vmstat allocstall counters, and an independent MemAvailable floor. Background kswapd scans and memcg direct scans do not qualify root pressure. Initial counters and resets provide no reclaim evidence. An absent lane slice is quiet; existing lane cgroups with missing, unreadable or malformed PSI remain unknown. Required missing, malformed or stale observations still close admission. IO PSI remains host-wide.

compatibility.detail: Existing psiBrake policies remain valid. Optional memoryAvailableFloorBytes defaults to the absolute value 2147483648 bytes (2 GiB) and applies independently of configured PSI rules. Zero disables the floor; a positive floor at or above MemTotal is an explicit configuration error.

downtime.detail: The new signal takes effect after daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
